title: Password recovery outage

trace.user_message: My password recovery page is unavailable. Check the service status. Is there a known problem?

nodes.final_answer:
Yes, there's a known problem. The account recovery service is showing an **outage**, so the recovery page being down is part of that and not something wrong on your side.

The status data doesn't say when it will be fixed, so I can't give you a repair time.

If you'd like, I can write up a local ticket draft. To do that, I'd need a short description of the problem and the steps you've already tried.
